settings.title: A set on us
settings.text: Tell us which of our aesthetics is most you — Coquette Dream, Clean Girl or Dark Feminine — and we'll send a set that actually suits your feed.

settings.title: Commission on every sale
settings.text: You get your own link and discount code. Anything sold through it earns you a cut, paid out automatically through Shopify Collabs.

settings.title: First look at new drops
settings.text: You'll see new designs before they go live, and you can tell us what you'd want us to make next. We do listen.
A real account you actually post to — Instagram, TikTok or Pinterest. We don't have a follower minimum, and we're not going to pretend we do.
You're comfortable showing your hands on camera. Nail content doesn't work as a repost.
You know how to apply press-ons — or you're happy to learn. We'll send you our guide either way.
You can post within about ten days of your set arriving. Life happens, but we'd rather agree on that up front.

settings.heading: Make something with us
settings.subheading: We send handmade press-on sets to creators who love them, and pay commission on every set they help sell. No follower minimum — just a real account and hands you're happy to film.
settings.cta_note: Takes about two minutes. We read every application ourselves.

settings.title: Apply
settings.description: Fill in the short form. It asks about your platform, your country, and how you'd like to work with us.

settings.title: We reply
settings.description: A person reads it — usually within a few days. If it's a fit, we'll ask which aesthetic you want.

settings.title: Your set arrives
settings.description: Shipped free, with everything you need to apply it. Wear it, film it, make it yours.

settings.title: Post and earn
settings.description: Share what you made and drop your link. Commission on every set sold through it.

settings.question: Do I need a certain number of followers?
settings.answer: No. We'd rather work with someone whose 800 followers actually trust them than someone with 80,000 who scrolls past. What we look at is whether your content feels like you — not the number under your name.

settings.question: What do I actually have to post?
settings.answer:
Whatever you'd have made anyway. An application video, a get-ready-with-me, a close-up of the set in your own light — it's your feed and your voice, and content that sounds like an advert doesn't work for either of us.

We'll ask for one piece within about ten days of your set arriving. Anything beyond that is up to you.

settings.question: Do I have to buy anything?
settings.answer: No. Your first set is on us, shipped free. There's no starter kit to purchase and no fee to join — if anyone ever asks you for one, it isn't us.

settings.question: How does the commission work?
settings.answer: You get a personal link and a discount code to share. Anything bought through either one is tracked automatically in Shopify Collabs, and your commission is paid out from there — you don't need to chase us or send an invoice.

settings.question: I've never worn press-ons before. Can I still apply?
settings.answer: Yes, and please say so on the form. We'll send you our application and removal guide with your set. A first-timer who prepped properly gets a far better result than a veteran who rushed it.

settings.question: Which countries can you send sets to?
settings.answer: We currently ship to 29 countries across North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East and Oceania. Tell us where you are on the form — if we don't reach you yet, it genuinely helps us to know.
